title: Documents next to the entries they belong to
description: Attachments can be read, picked out for sharing and restored after a move.

blocks.text: A photo of a document is useful at the moment the entry is opened. A file that cannot be seen, or did not come across, turns the archive into an unreliable hint.

quote.text: It’s so easy to both generate and store passwords.  But it also keeps copies of insurance cards, drivers license etc.  you can keep notes.

blocks.text: Tie material to the entry, show a preview and the supported formats. Let a chosen document be sent without opening the rest.
Check the size, the legibility and the contents of the export. Rights to a document and rights to a whole section of the vault have to differ.
